task: Controlled fixed-feature binary CIFAR-10 bird/cat learning from small-bag counts
features: Frozen torchvision ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1; official deterministic evaluation transform; pre-fc 512 features, per-image L2 normalization, append bias 1, divide all 513 coordinates by sqrt(2)
sampling: One fixed random permutation per CIFAR training class; all nine draw allocations disjoint; hidden instance labels used only for bag construction and evaluation
head_initialization: All 513 entries independently Uniform(-1/sqrt(513),1/sqrt(513)); bias random; no head filtering or balancing; shared across metrics
active_subspace: Within-bag zero-sum contrasts, dimension 18; fixed orthonormal Helmert basis P; bag-constant complement T
active_spectrum: 18 eigenvalues geometrically spaced from 4 down to 0.25
feature_metric: P Q diag(lambda) Q^T P^T + T T^T; Q is descending eigenbasis of P^T X X^T P
feature_reverse_metric: Reverse assignment of the same eigenvalues to the feature active eigenbasis
random_metrics: Two Gaussian-QR orthogonal active bases per draw; fixed before training; seed 2026090800+draw
isotropic_reference: trace-matched scalar sample identity; not isospectral and not parameter SGD
raw_reference: 4 X X^T / lambda_max(X X^T); scaled ordinary parameter-gradient reference, not isospectral
metric_information: Training input features, disclosed counts, fixed random seeds only; no hidden labels, test outcomes, target complete code or per-head optimization
rank_check: All 24 singular values retained; reject execution if sigma_min/sigma_max <= 1e-8; report rank failure, no sample replacement
update: y_next=y+eta*K*R, R=2*(exact count-posterior unary minus sigmoid(y)); refreshed every step; exact shared linear-head realization via X pseudoinverse
parameter_metric: M=Xplus K Xplus^T+(I-Xplus X); positive definite; y=Xw and w_next=w+eta*M*X^T*R
ascent_condition: eta*kappa_max*(N+1)=3.2<4; raw reference has its own measured positive lower eigenvalue
capture: First strict sum_b log(E_b)>-log(2); entire training code, never a bagwise certificate
well_fitted: All bag hard counts legal; mean bag legal probability >=0.95; minimum per-image modal probability >=0.90
empirical_endpoint: Well-fitted and same full hard code for the preceding 100 updates; require well-fitted final state and unchanged final 101-state code; unresolved runs retained
timing_diagnostics: first well-fitted state without waiting window
first MAP conditional complete-code posterior 0.90 (bagwise top-k logits; also report hard-code posterior separately, zero if illegal)
hindsight onset of final hard-code stability
lead_primary: (first well-fitted time - capture time)/first well-fitted time; include zero/negative values; report every component separately
continuation_adversary: Fix captured sign code as anchor. Minimize weakest anchored signed-coordinate drift over K=4I-3.75*u*u^T, either once at capture or every update. This adverse spectrum differs from the prefix spectrum but obeys the same 0.25..4 bounds; no hidden label use
evaluation: Concept accuracy on the 2,000 test images and exact count accuracy on 500 four-image bags from one seeded permutation.
